verses.job 29:12: Job 29:12 Because I delivered the poor who cried out, The fatherless and the one who had no helper.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:13: Job 29:13 The blessing of a perishing man came upon me, And I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:14: Job 29:14 I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; My justice was like a robe and a turban.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:15: Job 29:15 I was eyes to the blind, And I was feet to the lame.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:16: Job 29:16 I was a father to the poor, And I searched out the case that I did not know.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:17: Job 29:17 I broke the fangs of the wicked, And plucked the victim from his teeth.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:18: Job 29:18 "Then I said, "˜I shall die in my nest, And multiply my days as the sand.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:19: Job 29:19 My root is spread out to the waters, And the dew lies all night on my branch.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:20: Job 29:20 My glory is fresh within me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.'(NKJV)
verses.job 29:21: Job 29:21 "Men listened to me and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:22: Job 29:22 After my words they did not speak again, And my speech settled on them as dew.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:23: Job 29:23 They waited for me as for the rain, And they opened their mouth wide as for the spring rain.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:24: Job 29:24 If I mocked at them, they did not believe it, And the light of my countenance they did not cast down.(NKJV)
verses.job 29:25: Job 29:25 I chose the way for them, and sat as chief; So I dwelt as a king in the army, As one who comforts mourners.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:1: Job 30:1 "But now they mock at me, men younger than I, Whose fathers I disdained to put with the dogs of my flock.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:2: Job 30:2 Indeed, what profit is the strength of their hands to me? Their vigor has perished.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:3: Job 30:3 They are gaunt from want and famine, Fleeing late to the wilderness, desolate and waste,(NKJV)
verses.job 30:4: Job 30:4 Who pluck mallow by the bushes, And broom tree roots for their food.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:5: Job 30:5 They were driven out from among men, They shouted at them as at a thief.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:6: Job 30:6 They had to live in the clefts of the valleys, In caves of the earth and the rocks.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:7: Job 30:7 Among the bushes they brayed, Under the nettles they nestled.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:8: Job 30:8 They were sons of fools, Yes, sons of vile men; They were scourged from the land.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:9: Job 30:9 "And  now I am their taunting song; Yes, I am their byword.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:10: Job 30:10 They abhor me, they keep far from me; They do not hesitate to spit in my face.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:11: Job 30:11 Because He has loosed my bowstring and afflicted me, They have cast off restraint before me.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:12: Job 30:12 At my right hand the rabble arises; They push away my feet, And they raise against me their ways of destruction.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:13: Job 30:13 They break up my path, They promote my calamity; They have no helper.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:14: Job 30:14 They come as broad breakers; Under the ruinous storm they roll along.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:15: Job 30:15 Terrors are turned upon me; They pursue my honor as the wind, And my prosperity has passed like a cloud.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:16: Job 30:16 "And  now my soul is poured out because of my plight; The days of affliction take hold of me.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:17: Job 30:17 My bones are pierced in me at night, And my gnawing pains take no rest.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:18: Job 30:18 By great force my garment is disfigured; It binds me about as the collar of my coat.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:19: Job 30:19 He has cast me into the mire, And I have become like dust and ashes.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:20: Job 30:20 "I cry out to You, but You do not answer me; I stand up, and You regard me.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:21: Job 30:21 But You have become cruel to me; With the strength of Your hand You oppose me.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:22: Job 30:22 You lift me up to the wind and cause me to ride on it; You spoil my success.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:23: Job 30:23 For I know that You will bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:24: Job 30:24 "Surely He would not stretch out His hand against a heap of ruins, If they cry out when He destroys it.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:25: Job 30:25 Have I not wept for him who was in trouble? Has not my soul grieved for the poor?(NKJV)
verses.job 30:26: Job 30:26 But when I looked for good, evil came to me; And when I waited for light, then came darkness.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:27: Job 30:27 My heart is in turmoil and cannot rest; Days of affliction confront me.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:28: Job 30:28 I go about mourning, but not in the sun; I stand up in the assembly and cry out for help.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:29: Job 30:29 I am a brother of jackals, And a companion of ostriches.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:30: Job 30:30 My skin grows black and falls from me;  My bones burn with fever.(NKJV)
verses.job 30:31: Job 30:31 My harp is turned to mourning, And my flute to the voice of those who weep.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:1: Job 31:1 "I have made a covenant with my eyes; Why then should I look upon a young woman?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:2: Job 31:2 For what is the allotment of God from above, And the inheritance of the Almighty from on high?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:3: Job 31:3 Is it not destruction for the wicked, And disaster for the workers of iniquity?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:4: Job 31:4 Does He not see my ways, And count all my steps?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:5: Job 31:5 "If I have walked with falsehood, Or if my foot has hastened to deceit,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:6: Job 31:6 Let me be weighed on honest scales, That God may know my integrity.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:7: Job 31:7 If my step has turned from the way, Or my heart walked after my eyes, Or if any spot adheres to my hands,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:8: Job 31:8 Then let me sow, and another eat; Yes, let my harvest be rooted out.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:9: Job 31:9 "If my heart has been enticed by a woman, Or if I have lurked at my neighbor's door,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:10: Job 31:10 Then let my wife grind for another, And let others bow down over her.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:11: Job 31:11 For that would be wickedness; Yes, it would be iniquity deserving of judgment.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:12: Job 31:12 For that would be a fire that consumes to destruction, And would root out all my increase.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:13: Job 31:13 "If I have despised the cause of my male or female servant When they complained against me,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:14: Job 31:14 What then shall I do when God rises up? When He punishes, how shall I answer Him?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:15: Job 31:15 Did not He who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same One fashion us in the womb?(NKJV)
verses.job 31:16: Job 31:16 "If I have kept the poor from their desire, Or caused the eyes of the widow to fail,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:17: Job 31:17 Or eaten my morsel by myself, So that the fatherless could not eat of it(NKJV)
verses.job 31:18: Job 31:18 (But from my youth I reared him as a father, And from my mother's womb I guided the widow);(NKJV)
verses.job 31:19: Job 31:19 If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, Or any poor man without covering;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:20: Job 31:20 If his heart has not blessed me, And if he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:21: Job 31:21 If I have raised my hand against the fatherless, When I saw I had help in the gate;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:22: Job 31:22 Then let my arm fall from my shoulder, Let my arm be torn from the socket.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:23: Job 31:23 For destruction from God is a terror to me, And because of His magnificence I cannot endure.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:24: Job 31:24 "If  I have made gold my hope, Or said to fine gold, "˜You are my confidence';(NKJV)
verses.job 31:25: Job 31:25 If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gained much;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:26: Job 31:26 If I have observed the sun when it shines, Or the moon moving in brightness,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:27: Job 31:27 So that my heart has been secretly enticed, And my mouth has kissed my hand;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:28: Job 31:28 This also would be an iniquity deserving of judgment, For I would have denied God who is above.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:29: Job 31:29 "If  I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, Or lifted myself up when evil found him(NKJV)
verses.job 31:30: Job 31:30 (Indeed I have not allowed my mouth to sin By asking for a curse on his soul);(NKJV)
verses.job 31:31: Job 31:31 If the men of my tent have not said, "˜Who is there that has not been satisfied with his meat?'(NKJV)
verses.job 31:32: Job 31:32 (But no sojourner had to lodge in the street, For I have opened my doors to the traveler);(NKJV)
verses.job 31:33: Job 31:33 If I have covered my transgressions as Adam, By hiding my iniquity in my bosom,(NKJV)
verses.job 31:34: Job 31:34 Because I feared the great multitude, And dreaded the contempt of families, So that I kept silence And did not go out of the door"”(NKJV)
verses.job 31:35: Job 31:35 Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my mark. Oh,  that the Almighty would answer me, That my Prosecutor had written a book!(NKJV)
verses.job 31:36: Job 31:36 Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, And bind it on me like a crown;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:37: Job 31:37 I would declare to Him the number of my steps; Like a prince I would approach Him.(NKJV)
verses.job 31:38: Job 31:38 "If my land cries out against me, And its furrows weep together;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:39: Job 31:39 If I have eaten its fruit without money, Or caused its owners to lose their lives;(NKJV)
verses.job 31:40: Job 31:40 Then let thistles grow instead of wheat, And weeds instead of barley."  The words of Job are ended.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:1: Job 32:1 So these three men ceased answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:2: Job 32:2 Then the wrath of Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was aroused against Job; his wrath was aroused because he justified himself rather than God.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:3: Job 32:3 Also against his three friends his wrath was aroused, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:4: Job 32:4 Now because they were years older than he, Elihu had waited to speak to Job.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:5: Job 32:5 When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was aroused.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:6: Job 32:6 So Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, answered and said: "I am young in years, and you are very old; Therefore I was afraid, And dared not declare my opinion to you.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:7: Job 32:7 I said, "˜Age should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.'(NKJV)
verses.job 32:8: Job 32:8 But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty gives him understanding.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:9: Job 32:9 Great men are not always wise, Nor do the aged always understand justice.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:10: Job 32:10 "Therefore I say, "˜Listen to me, I also will declare my opinion.'(NKJV)
verses.job 32:11: Job 32:11 Indeed I waited for your words, I listened to your reasonings, while you searched out what to say.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:12: Job 32:12 I paid close attention to you; And surely not one of you convinced Job, Or answered his words"”(NKJV)
verses.job 32:13: Job 32:13 Lest you say, "˜We have found wisdom'; God will vanquish him, not man.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:14: Job 32:14 Now he has not directed his words against me; So I will not answer him with your words.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:15: Job 32:15 "They are dismayed and answer no more; Words escape them.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:16: Job 32:16 And I have waited, because they did not speak, Because they stood still and answered no more.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:17: Job 32:17 I also will answer my part, I too will declare my opinion.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:18: Job 32:18 For I am full of words; The spirit within me compels me.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:19: Job 32:19 Indeed my belly is like wine that has no vent; It is ready to burst like new wineskins.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:20: Job 32:20 I will speak, that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:21: Job 32:21 Let me not, I pray, show partiality to anyone; Nor let me flatter any man.(NKJV)
verses.job 32:22: Job 32:22 For I do not know how to flatter, Else my Maker would soon take me away.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:1: Job 33:1 "But please, Job, hear my speech, And listen to all my words.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:2: Job 33:2 Now, I open my mouth; My tongue speaks in my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:3: Job 33:3 My words come from my upright heart; My lips utter pure knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:4: Job 33:4 The Spirit of God has made me, And the breath of the Almighty gives me life.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:5: Job 33:5 If you can answer me, Set your words in order before me; Take your stand.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:6: Job 33:6 Truly I am as your spokesman before God; I also have been formed out of clay.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:7: Job 33:7 Surely no fear of me will terrify you, Nor will my hand be heavy on you.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:8: Job 33:8 "Surely you have spoken in my hearing, And I have heard the sound of your words, saying,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:9: Job 33:9 "˜I  am pure, without transgression; I am innocent, and there is no iniquity in me.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:10: Job 33:10 Yet He finds occasions against me,  He counts me as His enemy;(NKJV)
verses.job 33:11: Job 33:11 He puts my feet in the stocks, He watches all my paths.'(NKJV)
verses.job 33:12: Job 33:12 "Look, in this you are not righteous. I will answer you, For God is greater than man.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:13: Job 33:13 Why do you contend with Him? For He does not give an accounting of any of His words.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:14: Job 33:14 For God may speak in one way, or in another, Yet man does not perceive it.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:15: Job 33:15 In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falls upon men, While slumbering on their beds,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:16: Job 33:16 Then He opens the ears of men, And seals their instruction.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:17: Job 33:17 In order to turn man from his deed, And conceal pride from man,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:18: Job 33:18 He keeps back his soul from the Pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:19: Job 33:19 "Man is also chastened with pain on his bed, And with strong pain in many of his bones,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:20: Job 33:20 So that his life abhors bread, And his soul succulent food.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:21: Job 33:21 His flesh wastes away from sight, And his bones stick out which once were not seen.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:22: Job 33:22 Yes, his soul draws near the Pit, And his life to the executioners.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:23: Job 33:23 "If there is a messenger for him, A mediator, one among a thousand, To show man His uprightness,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:24: Job 33:24 Then He is gracious to him, and says, "˜Deliver him from going down to the Pit; I have found a ransom';(NKJV)
verses.job 33:25: Job 33:25 His flesh shall be young like a child's, He shall return to the days of his youth.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:26: Job 33:26 He shall pray to God, and He will delight in him, He shall see His face with joy, For He restores to man His righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:27: Job 33:27 Then he looks at men and says, "˜I have sinned, and perverted what was right, And it did not profit me.'(NKJV)
verses.job 33:28: Job 33:28 He will redeem his soul from going down to the Pit, And his life shall see the light.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:29: Job 33:29 "Behold, God works all these things, Twice, in fact, three times with a man,(NKJV)
verses.job 33:30: Job 33:30 To bring back his soul from the Pit, That he may be enlightened with the light of life.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:31: Job 33:31 "Give ear, Job, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will speak.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:32: Job 33:32 If you have anything to say, answer me; Speak, for I desire to justify you.(NKJV)
verses.job 33:33: Job 33:33 If not, listen to me; Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom."(NKJV)
verses.job 34:1: Job 34:1 Elihu further answered and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 34:2: Job 34:2 "Hear my words, you wise men; Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:3: Job 34:3 For the ear tests words As the palate tastes food.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:4: Job 34:4 Let us choose justice for ourselves; Let us know among ourselves what is good.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:5: Job 34:5 "For Job has said, "˜I am righteous, But God has taken away my justice;(NKJV)
verses.job 34:6: Job 34:6 Should I lie concerning my right? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.'(NKJV)
verses.job 34:7: Job 34:7 What man is like Job,  Who drinks scorn like water,(NKJV)
verses.job 34:8: Job 34:8 Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, And walks with wicked men?(NKJV)
verses.job 34:9: Job 34:9 For he has said, "˜It profits a man nothing That he should delight in God.'(NKJV)
verses.job 34:10: Job 34:10 "Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding:  Far be it from God to do wickedness, And from the Almighty to commit iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:11: Job 34:11 For He repays man according to his work, And makes man to find a reward according to his way.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:12: Job 34:12 Surely God will never do wickedly, Nor will the Almighty pervert justice.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:13: Job 34:13 Who gave Him charge over the earth? Or who appointed Him over the whole world?(NKJV)
verses.job 34:14: Job 34:14 If He should set His heart on it, If He should gather to Himself His Spirit and His breath,(NKJV)
verses.job 34:15: Job 34:15 All flesh would perish together, And man would return to dust.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:16: Job 34:16 "If you have understanding, hear this; Listen to the sound of my words:(NKJV)
verses.job 34:17: Job 34:17 Should one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn Him who is most just?(NKJV)
verses.job 34:18: Job 34:18 Is it fitting to say to a king, "˜You are worthless,' And to nobles, "˜You are wicked'?(NKJV)
verses.job 34:19: Job 34:19 Yet He is not partial to princes, Nor does He regard the rich more than the poor; For they are all the work of His hands.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:20: Job 34:20 In a moment they die, in the middle of the night; The people are shaken and pass away; The mighty are taken away without a hand.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:21: Job 34:21 "For  His eyes are on the ways of man, And He sees all his steps.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:22: Job 34:22 There is no darkness nor shadow of death Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:23: Job 34:23 For He need not further consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:24: Job 34:24 He breaks in pieces mighty men without inquiry, And sets others in their place.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:25: Job 34:25 Therefore He knows their works; He overthrows them in the night, And they are crushed.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:26: Job 34:26 He strikes them as wicked men In the open sight of others,(NKJV)
verses.job 34:27: Job 34:27 Because they turned back from Him, And would not consider any of His ways,(NKJV)
verses.job 34:28: Job 34:28 So that they caused the cry of the poor to come to Him; For He hears the cry of the afflicted.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:29: Job 34:29 When He gives quietness, who then can make trouble? And when He hides His face, who then can see Him, Whether it is against a nation or a man alone?"”(NKJV)
verses.job 34:30: Job 34:30 That the hypocrite should not reign, Lest the people be ensnared.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:31: Job 34:31 "For has anyone said to God, "˜I have borne chastening; I will offend no more;(NKJV)
verses.job 34:32: Job 34:32 Teach me what I do not see; If I have done iniquity, I will do no more'?(NKJV)
verses.job 34:33: Job 34:33 Should He repay it according to your terms, Just because you disavow it? You must choose, and not I; Therefore speak what you know.(NKJV)
verses.job 34:34: Job 34:34 "Men of understanding say to me, Wise men who listen to me:(NKJV)
verses.job 34:35: Job 34:35 "˜Job  speaks without knowledge, His words are without wisdom.'(NKJV)
verses.job 34:36: Job 34:36 Oh, that Job were tried to the utmost, Because his answers are like those of wicked men!(NKJV)
verses.job 34:37: Job 34:37 For he adds rebellion to his sin; He claps his hands among us, And multiplies his words against God."(NKJV)
verses.job 35:1: Job 35:1 Moreover Elihu answered and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 35:2: Job 35:2 "Do you think this is right? Do you say, "˜My righteousness is more than God's'?(NKJV)
verses.job 35:3: Job 35:3 For you say, "˜What advantage will it be to You? What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?'(NKJV)
verses.job 35:4: Job 35:4 "I will answer you, And your companions with you.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:5: Job 35:5 Look to the heavens and see; And behold the clouds"” They are higher than you.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:6: Job 35:6 If you sin, what do you accomplish against Him? Or, if your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to Him?(NKJV)
verses.job 35:7: Job 35:7 If you are righteous, what do you give Him? Or what does He receive from your hand?(NKJV)
verses.job 35:8: Job 35:8 Your wickedness affects a man such as you, And your righteousness a son of man.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:9: Job 35:9 "Because  of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry out for help because of the arm of the mighty.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:10: Job 35:10 But no one says, "˜Where is God my Maker,  Who gives songs in the night,(NKJV)
verses.job 35:11: Job 35:11 Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, And makes us wiser than the birds of heaven?'(NKJV)
verses.job 35:12: Job 35:12 There they cry out, but He does not answer, Because of the pride of evil men.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:13: Job 35:13 Surely God will not listen to empty talk, Nor will the Almighty regard it.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:14: Job 35:14 Although you say you do not see Him, Yet justice is before Him, and you must wait for Him.(NKJV)
verses.job 35:15: Job 35:15 And now, because He has not punished in His anger, Nor taken much notice of folly,(NKJV)
verses.job 35:16: Job 35:16 Therefore Job opens his mouth in vain; He multiplies words without knowledge."(NKJV)
verses.job 36:1: Job 36:1 Elihu also proceeded and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 36:2: Job 36:2 "Bear with me a little, and I will show you That there are yet words to speak on God's behalf.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:3: Job 36:3 I will fetch my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:4: Job 36:4 For truly my words are not false; One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:5: Job 36:5 "Behold, God is mighty, but despises no one;  He is mighty in strength of understanding.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:6: Job 36:6 He does not preserve the life of the wicked, But gives justice to the oppressed.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:7: Job 36:7 He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous; But they are on the throne with kings, For He has seated them forever, And they are exalted.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:8: Job 36:8 And if they are bound in fetters, Held in the cords of affliction,(NKJV)
verses.job 36:9: Job 36:9 Then He tells them their work and their transgressions"” That they have acted defiantly.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:10: Job 36:10 He also opens their ear to instruction, And commands that they turn from iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:11: Job 36:11 If they obey and serve Him, They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:12: Job 36:12 But if they do not obey, They shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:13: Job 36:13 "But the hypocrites in heart store up wrath; They do not cry for help when He binds them.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:14: Job 36:14 They die in youth, And their life ends among the perverted persons.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:15: Job 36:15 He delivers the poor in their affliction, And opens their ears in oppression.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:16: Job 36:16 "Indeed He would have brought you out of dire distress,  Into a broad place where there is no restraint; And what is set on your table would be full of richness.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:17: Job 36:17 But you are filled with the judgment due the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold of you.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:18: Job 36:18 Because there is wrath, beware lest He take you away with one blow; For a large ransom would not help you avoid it.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:19: Job 36:19 Will your riches, Or all the mighty forces, Keep you from distress?(NKJV)
verses.job 36:20: Job 36:20 Do not desire the night, When people are cut off in their place.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:21: Job 36:21 Take heed, do not turn to iniquity, For you have chosen this rather than affliction.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:22: Job 36:22 "Behold, God is exalted by His power; Who teaches like Him?(NKJV)
verses.job 36:23: Job 36:23 Who has assigned Him His way, Or who has said, "˜You have done wrong'?(NKJV)
verses.job 36:24: Job 36:24 "Remember to magnify His work, Of which men have sung.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:25: Job 36:25 Everyone has seen it; Man looks on it from afar.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:26: Job 36:26 "Behold, God is great, and we do not know Him;  Nor can the number of His years be discovered.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:27: Job 36:27 For He draws up drops of water, Which distill as rain from the mist,(NKJV)
verses.job 36:28: Job 36:28 Which the clouds drop down And pour abundantly on man.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:29: Job 36:29 Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of clouds, The thunder from His canopy?(NKJV)
verses.job 36:30: Job 36:30 Look, He scatters His light upon it, And covers the depths of the sea.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:31: Job 36:31 For by these He judges the peoples; He gives food in abundance.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:32: Job 36:32 He covers His hands with lightning, And commands it to strike.(NKJV)
verses.job 36:33: Job 36:33 His thunder declares it, The cattle also, concerning the rising storm.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:1: Job 37:1 "At this also my heart trembles, And leaps from its place.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:2: Job 37:2 Hear attentively the thunder of His voice, And the rumbling that comes from His mouth.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:3: Job 37:3 He sends it forth under the whole heaven, His lightning to the ends of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:4: Job 37:4 After it a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, And He does not restrain them when His voice is heard.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:5: Job 37:5 God thunders marvelously with His voice;  He does great things which we cannot comprehend.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:6: Job 37:6 For He says to the snow, "˜Fall on the earth'; Likewise to the gentle rain and the heavy rain of His strength.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:7: Job 37:7 He seals the hand of every man,  That all men may know His work.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:8: Job 37:8 The beasts go into dens, And remain in their lairs.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:9: Job 37:9 From the chamber of the south comes the whirlwind, And cold from the scattering winds of the north.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:10: Job 37:10 By the breath of God ice is given, And the broad waters are frozen.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:11: Job 37:11 Also with moisture He saturates the thick clouds; He scatters His bright clouds.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:12: Job 37:12 And they swirl about, being turned by His guidance, That they may do whatever He commands them On the face of the whole earth.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:13: Job 37:13 He causes it to come, Whether for correction, Or for His land, Or for mercy.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:14: Job 37:14 "Listen to this, O Job; Stand still and consider the wondrous works of God.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:15: Job 37:15 Do you know when God dispatches them, And causes the light of His cloud to shine?(NKJV)
verses.job 37:16: Job 37:16 Do you know how the clouds are balanced, Those wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?(NKJV)
verses.job 37:17: Job 37:17 Why are your garments hot, When He quiets the earth by the south wind?(NKJV)
verses.job 37:18: Job 37:18 With Him, have you spread out the skies, Strong as a cast metal mirror?(NKJV)
verses.job 37:19: Job 37:19 "Teach us what we should say to Him, For we can prepare nothing because of the darkness.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:20: Job 37:20 Should He be told that I wish to speak? If a man were to speak, surely he would be swallowed up.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:21: Job 37:21 Even now men cannot look at the light when it is bright in the skies, When the wind has passed and cleared them.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:22: Job 37:22 He comes from the north as golden splendor; With God is awesome majesty.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:23: Job 37:23 As for the Almighty, we cannot find Him;  He is excellent in power, In judgment and abundant justice; He does not oppress.(NKJV)
verses.job 37:24: Job 37:24 Therefore men fear Him; He shows no partiality to any who are wise of heart."(NKJV)
verses.job 38:1: Job 38:1 Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 38:2: Job 38:2 "Who  is this who darkens counsel By words without knowledge?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:3: Job 38:3 Now prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:4: Job 38:4 "Where  were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:5: Job 38:5 Who determined its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched the line upon it?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:6: Job 38:6 To what were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:7: Job 38:7 When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:8: Job 38:8 "Or  who shut in the sea with doors, When it burst forth and issued from the womb;(NKJV)
verses.job 38:9: Job 38:9 When I made the clouds its garment, And thick darkness its swaddling band;(NKJV)
verses.job 38:10: Job 38:10 When I fixed My limit for it, And set bars and doors;(NKJV)
verses.job 38:11: Job 38:11 When I said, "˜This far you may come, but no farther, And here your proud waves must stop!'(NKJV)
verses.job 38:12: Job 38:12 "Have you commanded the morning since your days began, And caused the dawn to know its place,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:13: Job 38:13 That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:14: Job 38:14 It takes on form like clay under a seal, And stands out like a garment.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:15: Job 38:15 From the wicked their light is withheld, And the upraised arm is broken.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:16: Job 38:16 "Have you entered the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in search of the depths?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:17: Job 38:17 Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:18: Job 38:18 Have you comprehended the breadth of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:19: Job 38:19 "Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And darkness, where is its place,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:20: Job 38:20 That you may take it to its territory, That you may know the paths to its home?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:21: Job 38:21 Do you know it, because you were born then, Or because the number of your days is great?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:22: Job 38:22 "Have you entered the treasury of snow, Or have you seen the treasury of hail,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:23: Job 38:23 Which I have reserved for the time of trouble, For the day of battle and war?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:24: Job 38:24 By what way is light diffused, Or the east wind scattered over the earth?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:25: Job 38:25 "Who has divided a channel for the overflowing water, Or a path for the thunderbolt,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:26: Job 38:26 To cause it to rain on a land where there is no one, A wilderness in which there is no man;(NKJV)
verses.job 38:27: Job 38:27 To satisfy the desolate waste, And cause to spring forth the growth of tender grass?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:28: Job 38:28 Has the rain a father? Or who has begotten the drops of dew?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:29: Job 38:29 From whose womb comes the ice? And the frost of heaven, who gives it birth?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:30: Job 38:30 The waters harden like stone, And the surface of the deep is frozen.(NKJV)
verses.job 38:31: Job 38:31 "Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the belt of Orion?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:32: Job 38:32 Can you bring out Mazzaroth in its season? Or can you guide the Great Bear with its cubs?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:33: Job 38:33 Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:34: Job 38:34 "Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That an abundance of water may cover you?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:35: Job 38:35 Can you send out lightnings, that they may go, And say to you, "˜Here we are!'?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:36: Job 38:36 Who has put wisdom in the mind? Or who has given understanding to the heart?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:37: Job 38:37 Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:38: Job 38:38 When the dust hardens in clumps, And the clods cling together?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:39: Job 38:39 "Can  you hunt the prey for the lion, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,(NKJV)
verses.job 38:40: Job 38:40 When they crouch in their dens, Or lurk in their lairs to lie in wait?(NKJV)
verses.job 38:41: Job 38:41 Who provides food for the raven, When its young ones cry to God, And wander about for lack of food?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:1: Job 39:1 "Do you know the time when the wild mountain goats bear young? Or can you mark when the deer gives birth?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:2: Job 39:2 Can you number the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they bear young?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:3: Job 39:3 They bow down, They bring forth their young, They deliver their offspring.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:4: Job 39:4 Their young ones are healthy, They grow strong with grain; They depart and do not return to them.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:5: Job 39:5 "Who set the wild donkey free? Who loosed the bonds of the onager,(NKJV)
verses.job 39:6: Job 39:6 Whose home I have made the wilderness, And the barren land his dwelling?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:7: Job 39:7 He scorns the tumult of the city; He does not heed the shouts of the driver.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:8: Job 39:8 The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searches after every green thing.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:9: Job 39:9 "Will the wild ox be willing to serve you? Will he bed by your manger?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:10: Job 39:10 Can you bind the wild ox in the furrow with ropes? Or will he plow the valleys behind you?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:11: Job 39:11 Will you trust him because his strength is great? Or will you leave your labor to him?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:12: Job 39:12 Will you trust him to bring home your grain, And gather it to your threshing floor?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:13: Job 39:13 "The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, But are her wings and pinions like the kindly stork's?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:14: Job 39:14 For she leaves her eggs on the ground, And warms them in the dust;(NKJV)
verses.job 39:15: Job 39:15 She forgets that a foot may crush them, Or that a wild beast may break them.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:16: Job 39:16 She treats her young harshly, as though they were not hers; Her labor is in vain, without concern,(NKJV)
verses.job 39:17: Job 39:17 Because God deprived her of wisdom, And did not endow her with understanding.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:18: Job 39:18 When she lifts herself on high, She scorns the horse and its rider.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:19: Job 39:19 "Have you given the horse strength? Have you clothed his neck with thunder?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:20: Job 39:20 Can you frighten him like a locust? His majestic snorting strikes terror.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:21: Job 39:21 He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength;  He gallops into the clash of arms.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:22: Job 39:22 He mocks at fear, and is not frightened; Nor does he turn back from the sword.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:23: Job 39:23 The quiver rattles against him, The glittering spear and javelin.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:24: Job 39:24 He devours the distance with fierceness and rage; Nor does he come to a halt because the trumpet has sounded.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:25: Job 39:25 At the blast of the trumpet he says, "˜Aha!' He smells the battle from afar, The thunder of captains and shouting.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:26: Job 39:26 "Does the hawk fly by your wisdom, And spread its wings toward the south?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:27: Job 39:27 Does the eagle mount up at your command, And make its nest on high?(NKJV)
verses.job 39:28: Job 39:28 On the rock it dwells and resides, On the crag of the rock and the stronghold.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:29: Job 39:29 From there it spies out the prey; Its eyes observe from afar.(NKJV)
verses.job 39:30: Job 39:30 Its young ones suck up blood; And where the slain are, there it is."(NKJV)
verses.job 40:1: Job 40:1 Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 40:2: Job 40:2 "Shall the one who contends with the Almighty correct Him? He who rebukes God, let him answer it."(NKJV)
verses.job 40:3: Job 40:3 Then Job answered the LORD and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 40:4: Job 40:4 "Behold,  I am vile; What shall I answer You?  I lay my hand over my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:5: Job 40:5 Once I have spoken, but I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further."(NKJV)
verses.job 40:6: Job 40:6 Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 40:7: Job 40:7 "Now  prepare yourself like a man;  I will question you, and you shall answer Me:(NKJV)
verses.job 40:8: Job 40:8 "Would  you indeed annul My judgment? Would you condemn Me that you may be justified?(NKJV)
verses.job 40:9: Job 40:9 Have you an arm like God? Or can you thunder with a voice like His?(NKJV)
verses.job 40:10: Job 40:10 Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor, And array yourself with glory and beauty.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:11: Job 40:11 Disperse the rage of your wrath; Look on everyone who is proud, and humble him.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:12: Job 40:12 Look on everyone who is proud, and bring him low; Tread down the wicked in their place.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:13: Job 40:13 Hide them in the dust together, Bind their faces in hidden darkness.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:14: Job 40:14 Then I will also confess to you That your own right hand can save you.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:15: Job 40:15 "Look now at the behemoth, which I made along with you; He eats grass like an ox.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:16: Job 40:16 See now, his strength is in his hips, And his power is in his stomach muscles.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:17: Job 40:17 He moves his tail like a cedar; The sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:18: Job 40:18 His bones are like beams of bronze, His ribs like bars of iron.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:19: Job 40:19 He is the first of the ways of God; Only He who made him can bring near His sword.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:20: Job 40:20 Surely the mountains yield food for him, And all the beasts of the field play there.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:21: Job 40:21 He lies under the lotus trees, In a covert of reeds and marsh.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:22: Job 40:22 The lotus trees cover him with their shade; The willows by the brook surround him.(NKJV)
verses.job 40:23: Job 40:23 Indeed the river may rage, Yet he is not disturbed; He is confident, though the Jordan gushes into his mouth,(NKJV)
verses.job 40:24: Job 40:24 Though he takes it in his eyes, Or one pierces his nose with a snare.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:1: Job 41:1 "Can you draw out Leviathan with a hook, Or snare his tongue with a line which you lower?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:2: Job 41:2 Can you put a reed through his nose, Or pierce his jaw with a hook?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:3: Job 41:3 Will he make many supplications to you? Will he speak softly to you?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:4: Job 41:4 Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:5: Job 41:5 Will you play with him as with a bird, Or will you leash him for your maidens?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:6: Job 41:6 Will your companions make a banquet of him? Will they apportion him among the merchants?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:7: Job 41:7 Can you fill his skin with harpoons, Or his head with fishing spears?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:8: Job 41:8 Lay your hand on him; Remember the battle"” Never do it again!(NKJV)
verses.job 41:9: Job 41:9 Indeed, any hope of overcoming him is false; Shall one not be overwhelmed at the sight of him?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:10: Job 41:10 No one is so fierce that he would dare stir him up. Who then is able to stand against Me?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:11: Job 41:11 Who has preceded Me, that I should pay him?  Everything under heaven is Mine.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:12: Job 41:12 "I will not conceal his limbs, His mighty power, or his graceful proportions.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:13: Job 41:13 Who can remove his outer coat? Who can approach him with a double bridle?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:14: Job 41:14 Who can open the doors of his face, With his terrible teeth all around?(NKJV)
verses.job 41:15: Job 41:15 His rows of scales are his pride, Shut up tightly as with a seal;(NKJV)
verses.job 41:16: Job 41:16 One is so near another That no air can come between them;(NKJV)
verses.job 41:17: Job 41:17 They are joined one to another, They stick together and cannot be parted.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:18: Job 41:18 His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:19: Job 41:19 Out of his mouth go burning lights; Sparks of fire shoot out.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:20: Job 41:20 Smoke goes out of his nostrils, As from a boiling pot and burning rushes.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:21: Job 41:21 His breath kindles coals, And a flame goes out of his mouth.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:22: Job 41:22 Strength dwells in his neck, And sorrow dances before him.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:23: Job 41:23 The folds of his flesh are joined together; They are firm on him and cannot be moved.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:24: Job 41:24 His heart is as hard as stone, Even as hard as the lower millstone.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:25: Job 41:25 When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; Because of his crashings they are beside themselves.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:26: Job 41:26 Though the sword reaches him, it cannot avail; Nor does spear, dart, or javelin.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:27: Job 41:27 He regards iron as straw, And bronze as rotten wood.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:28: Job 41:28 The arrow cannot make him flee; Slingstones become like stubble to him.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:29: Job 41:29 Darts are regarded as straw; He laughs at the threat of javelins.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:30: Job 41:30 His undersides are like sharp potsherds; He spreads pointed marks in the mire.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:31: Job 41:31 He makes the deep boil like a pot; He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:32: Job 41:32 He leaves a shining wake behind him; One would think the deep had white hair.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:33: Job 41:33 On earth there is nothing like him, Which is made without fear.(NKJV)
verses.job 41:34: Job 41:34 He beholds every high thing; He is king over all the children of pride."(NKJV)
verses.job 42:1: Job 42:1 Then Job answered the LORD and said:(NKJV)
verses.job 42:2: Job 42:2 "I know that You can do everything, And that no purpose of Yours can be withheld from You.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:3: Job 42:3 You asked, "˜Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?' Therefore I have uttered what I did not understand,  Things too wonderful for me, which I did not know.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:4: Job 42:4 Listen, please, and let me speak; You said, "˜I will question you, and you shall answer Me.'(NKJV)
verses.job 42:5: Job 42:5 "I have heard of You by the hearing of the ear, But now my eye sees You.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:6: Job 42:6 Therefore I abhor myself, And repent in dust and ashes."(NKJV)
verses.job 42:7: Job 42:7 And so it was, after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, that the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "My wrath is aroused against you and your two friends, for you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:8: Job 42:8 Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and My servant Job shall pray for you. For I will accept him, lest I deal with you according to your folly; because you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has."(NKJV)
verses.job 42:9: Job 42:9 So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD commanded them; for the LORD had accepted Job.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:10: Job 42:10 And the LORD restored Job's losses when he prayed for his friends. Indeed the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:11: Job 42:11 Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been his acquaintances before, came to him and ate food with him in his house; and they consoled him and comforted him for all the adversity that the LORD had brought upon him. Each one gave him a piece of silver and each a ring of gold.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:12: Job 42:12 Now the LORD blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; for he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and one thousand female donkeys.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:13: Job 42:13 He also had seven sons and three daughters.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:14: Job 42:14 And he called the name of the first Jemimah, the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-Happuch.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:15: Job 42:15 In all the land were found no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:16: Job 42:16 After this Job lived one hundred and forty years, and saw his children and grandchildren for four generations.(NKJV)
verses.job 42:17: Job 42:17 So Job died, old and full of days.(NKJV)
